Package com.kerosene.kfe.ledger.domain

Class KfeLedgerMovementTypes

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.ledger.domain.KfeLedgerMovementTypes
public final class KfeLedgerMovementTypes extends Object
Canonical movement types that credit the AVAILABLE bucket (or system profit). Used for dual-path guards and partial unique index on balance_movements.

  • Method Details

    • isIdempotentCreditType

      public static boolean isIdempotentCreditType(String movementType)
      Tests whether a persisted movement type is one of the supported idempotent available-side credits. Unknown and null strings fail closed.
      Parameters:
      movementType - stored movement type to classify
      Returns:
      true only for a member of IDEMPOTENT_CREDIT_TYPE_SET

    • isIdempotentMovementType

      public static boolean isIdempotentMovementType(String movementType)
      Tests whether a movement is protected by the legacy ledger's credit or compensation idempotency rules.
      Parameters:
      movementType - stored movement type to classify
      Returns:
      true when the type belongs to either idempotent category
